pair.title: Connect to your server
pair.intro: VidFriends runs on a server someone you trust operates. Scan the QR code from your invite, or paste the join link or server address.
pair.noDefault: There is no public VidFriends server. Ask the friend who invited you for their link.
pair.cameraNeeded: VidFriends needs the camera to scan the QR code.

errors.empty: Paste a link or address first.
errors.invalid: That doesn't look like a link.
errors.unreachable: Couldn't reach that server. Check the address and your connection.
errors.not_vidfriends: That server isn't a VidFriends server.
errors.incompatible: This server runs a version the app doesn't support. Update the app or ask the operator to upgrade.
errors.insecure: This address uses plain http://. VidFriends servers need https://, because passkeys only work over a secure connection.

login.title: Sign in
login.passkeyHelp: You sign in with the passkey you created when you joined. Your browser opens this server's sign-in page and brings you back to the app.
login.noAccount: No account yet? Open an invite link from a friend.
login.lostPasskey: Lost your passkey? Ask your server admin for a recovery link.
login.handoffInvalid: This sign-in didn't come from the app or has expired.
login.tryAgain: Start again from the sign-in screen.

join.title: Join {{name}}
join.passkeyHelp: Your browser opens this server's join page. Choose a username there and create a passkey (fingerprint, face or screen lock); then you come back to the app, signed in.

feed.expired: This video was cleaned up from the server.
feed.linkOnly: This video can only be watched on the original site.
feed.processing: Still processing — check back in a moment.
feed.empty: When friends send you videos, they show up here.

state.link_only: This site doesn't allow downloads — friends get a link to the original.
state.expired: The video file was cleaned up.

send.pickVideo: Choose a video from your phone
send.noFriends: Add friends first on the Friends tab.

state.link_only: This site doesn't allow downloads — friends get a link to the original.

friends.noFriends: No friends yet. Search for someone above.

settings.title: Settings
settings.pushUnavailable: Push notifications aren't available in this build of the app. You still see everything under Notifications.
settings.pushDenied: Notifications are turned off for VidFriends in your phone's settings.
settings.privatePreviewsHelp: Hide names on your lock screen. Change this before turning push on.
settings.switchServer: Sign out and use a different server
settings.webOnly: Profile, password, sessions and account deletion are managed in the web app on your server.
settings.exportHelp: Get a ZIP file with your profile, friends, the videos you sent and received with their notes and conversations, and your sign-in history. It is prepared on your server and can be downloaded for 7 days.
settings.exportIncludeMedia: Include the video files I added
settings.exportRateLimited: You can prepare your data 3 times a day. Try again tomorrow.

offline.title: Downloads
offline.help: Downloads stay on this phone only and play without a connection. They are removed when you sign out, and when the sender unsends the video or your server removes it.
offline.empty: Nothing downloaded yet. Open a video you received and choose Download for offline.
offline.missing: This download is no longer on this phone.

errors.over_cap: This would go over your storage limit. Remove a download or raise the limit in Downloads.
errors.no_space: Not enough free space on this phone.
errors.not_ready: This video isn't ready to download yet.
errors.failed: The download failed. Check your connection and try again.

collections.title: Collections
collections.help: Keep saved videos in named lists. Videos in a collection stay saved.
collections.name: Name
collections.empty: No videos in this collection yet. Add them from a video's page.
collections.addHelp: Tick the collections this video belongs in, or make a new one. It is saved too.
